description: Open a drafted social thread to post the reply yourself: returns the thread URL (for X, a link that opens X's composer with the reply filled in) and starts four checks over 72 hours that mark the thread Posted once your reply is found there. Pass text to use an edited reply; X replies must be 280 characters or fewer.

text.description: Your edited reply. Leave it out to use the draft.

name: open_social_thread
